name: יְדוּתוּן
summary: David set Jeduthun and his sons apart for music. He played the harp to give thanks and praise to Yahweh. Psalm 39 names him in its heading, and Chronicles names a returning Levite’s ancestor by the same name.
note: The musical office supports a connection with thanksgiving. Scripture gives no naming explanation. Both readings of the Psalm heading refer to this name.
